blocks.text: Contribute read-only artwork with contributeVehicleAppearance. Compose createVehicleArtwork from presentation contributions and pass it as Render2DOptions.vehicles to Canvas or WebGL. Both use the same screen-space triangle-fan hull and throttle flame. Omitting artwork leaves a generic position marker; headless worlds need no appearance, camera, controls or DOM. Artwork never changes handling, save identity or collision.
